title: tellima laciniata
intro: Tellima laciniata, commonly known as fringe cups or fringed penstemon, is a perennial plant native to the Pacific Northwest region of North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its use to treat a range of health issues, such as fever, coughs, and sore throats, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Tellima laciniata include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
